note: Vented 25 mm coin exciter. Coil mass is the sheet's Mms. Suspension stiffness is derived as Mms*(2π·Fs)² = 3655 N/m (sheet Cms 0.0003 matches that as m/N; the sheet's mm/N label is treated as a unit typo). Magnet mass is the published product weight 77.5 g (SoundImports) minus Mms. Qms and Xmax are not published; suspension loss is left at zero and travel is unlimited in the model with a label. Read 2026-11-25.
